scoring_justification: The core computational workflow (DFT HSE06 and phonon dispersion) cannot be re-run in the verifier; the checker verifies that the agent's reported electronic band energies, phonon frequencies, and orbital/DOS qualitative statements are consistent with the paper's HSE06 results within generous tolerances to absorb toolchain differences.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference band energies and orbital characters
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 4a: HSE06 electronic structure; band energies a = -1.3 eV, b = -0.3 eV, c = 1.6 eV, d = -2.6 eV. Orbital characters from Fig. 4b: band c dominated by d_xy, d_xz, d_z2; band d dominated by d_z2.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported values in text and figures.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the authoritative paper-reported HSE06 results used to verify reproduction.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference phonon frequencies and DOS comparison
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 4c and text: A1g mode ~200 cm⁻¹, Eg ~128 cm⁻¹, and A1g DOS higher than Eg.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's computed phonon results; used as verification standard.

required.bands: object with keys a,b,c,d each a number (energy in eV)
required.orbital_characters: object with keys c and d each a list of strings

outputs.description: Orbital-resolved electronic band energies and dominant Ti d-orbital contributions for Ti3C2O2.

required.phonon_modes: object with keys A1g and Eg each a number (frequency in cm⁻¹)

outputs.description: Phonon frequencies of A1g and Eg modes and the qualitative phonon DOS comparison.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the agent's reported band energies (relative to Fermi level) and dominant orbital characters against the paper's HSE06-computed values with reasonable tolerances. Phonon frequencies and the DOS comparison are similarly checked against the paper's reported results. Tolerances accommodate differences due to pseudopotential/functional choices.
